findings.title: small-action button no longer floats right after container became flex
findings.body: This PR makes `.small-action` a flex container (`@include flexbox()`). In a flex container, `float` on children is ignored, so `float: right` on the `button` rule no longer works. Nothing replaces it: there is no `margin-left: auto` and no `justify-content`. As a result, the edit/delete button in small-action posts now sits immediately after the description text instead of at the right edge. Add `margin-left: auto` to the button. `float: left` on `.topic-avatar` and `clear: both` are also dead code now.

findings.title: Header panel alignment relies on auto margins unsupported by the legacy -webkit-box fallback
findings.body: `float: right` on `.panel` was replaced by `margin-left: auto`. The new `flexbox()` mixin deliberately emits `display: -webkit-box` / `-moz-box` for old browsers. The 2009 box model does not distribute auto margins, so in those browsers the panel (search, hamburger, user icons) is no longer pushed to the right. It ends up packed next to the title, which is a regression from the previous float layout. Either drop the legacy fallbacks or add a legacy-compatible way to push the panel right, such as `-webkit-box-flex` on the title or `-webkit-box-pack: justify`.

findings.title: align-items mixin emits a nonexistent property and passes unmapped values to the old syntax
findings.body: `-ms-align-items` is not a real property; IE10 uses `-ms-flex-align`. The mixin also passes `$alignment` unchanged to `-webkit-box-align` and `-ms-flex-align`. Those properties only accept `start`/`end`/`center`/`baseline`/`stretch`, so any future call with `flex-start` or `flex-end` silently fails on the prefixed syntaxes. Remove the bogus property and map `flex-start`/`flex-end` to `start`/`end`.
